incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered — REDWOOD-API-P99-ERRS at 2025-11-03T02:13:09Z
sanjay: got the page, looking into noisy spikes on /infer route :mag:
maria: same, dashboards show sharp spikes concentrated to a couple of customer prefixes (not global)
kevin: PD is getting a wall of parallel alerts. can we reduce fanout or dedupe at the router level temporarily?
jules: +1. propose dedupe by customer_id and a per-key rate limit (eg 3 pages / 2m). keeps urgent unique faults flowing but stops avalanche
sanjay: on it — pushing a temporary routing filter now, will post snippet when live
sanjay: ```
# temporary routing filter (edge router)
routes:
  - match: "/infer*"
    actions:
      - dedupe: true
        dedupe_key: request.customer_id
        window_sec: 120
        max_per_window: 3
      - rate_limit: true
        key: request.customer_id
        limit: 5
        period_sec: 60
```
maria: adding a small Grafana panel: "PD pages by dedupe_key" + heatmap for bursty keys so we can watch the filter effectiveness
oncall-sre: quick reminder: before muting any alerts, confirm customer impact scope. if >5% accounts affected we escalate instead of suppressing
sanjay: confirmed: impact limited to 2 customers running heavy batch jobs. isolation looks clean, no general capacity drop
kevin: I created a temporary PD rule to suppress duplicate page notifications from the same host within 2m while we test the router dedupe :white_check_mark:
jules: next steps: 1) keep router dedupe for 2 hours, 2) revert if we see missed unique errors, 3) follow up with alert-threshold tuning and aggregation key in Alertmanager
maria: I'll own dashboards and a quick RFC for sticky dedupe keys + heatmap retention settings
kevin: I'll write the short post-incident note and update the oncall runbook with the new dedupe knobs
oncall-sre: please add a customer-impact blurb so support can proactively notify impacted customers if needed
sanjay: added a short note to the incident thread and put a follow-up task: INC-719 (alert fanout control + dashboard)
incident-bot: Incident mitigated — REDWOOD-API-P99-ERRS. Router dedupe active. Follow-ups: INC-719 (owner: maria), INC-720 (owner: kevin)
maria: thanks everyone — watchparty over, will monitor heatmap for 30m then let dedupe sleep unless we see regression :party_parrot:
